description: LLM provider SDKs self-update: Renovate opens a bump PR the day a release ships; minor/patch bumps auto-merge when the full CI suite (including the agent-loop integration tests against Postgres) passes. Majors wait for a human because that's where SDKs break signatures.

packageRules.description: Provider SDKs — the wire-format guardians. Grouped so one PR bumps them together.
Major SDK bumps need human eyes — signature breaks live here.
Everything else: weekly, no automerge — keep noise low.
